dataset_contract.split_policy: Chronological market-group split with one-market embargo at train/validation and validation/test boundaries; no feature-row shuffle.
dataset_contract.feature_expansion_policy: Existing immutable core-v1 natural keys are preserved before recomputation during Phase 7 historical expansion; static market metadata must still match. Missing natural keys are generated from the expanded verified history. Default feature generation remains strict and conflicts fail closed.

models.interpretation: The simple Polymarket market-price baseline is the validation champion for both verified horizons. XGBoost did not satisfy the documented validation/test promotion rule for either horizon, so Phase 7 does not justify additional model complexity. Offset examples are descriptive accepted-report metrics and are not a Phase 7 timing-selection decision.

source_availability.bybit_spot: audited unavailable on production host via documented HTTP 403 restriction
source_availability.bybit_linear: audited unavailable on production host via documented HTTP 403 restriction
source_availability.policy: No route-around and no synthesized Bybit history.

production_incidents_and_regressions.issue: Phase 7 preflight could appear stalled because a full storage aggregate report ran before candidate installation.
production_incidents_and_regressions.resolution: Use lightweight disk-health preflight and retain full aggregate storage report only after research work.

production_incidents_and_regressions.issue: Root-created detached worktree could not be built by bp because package metadata generation lacked write permission.
production_incidents_and_regressions.resolution: Separate verified Git provenance from unprivileged build source by exporting the exact commit with git archive into a bp-owned non-Git source directory.

production_incidents_and_regressions.issue: Changing Git worktree ownership exposed Git dubious-ownership/shared-gitdir behavior.
production_incidents_and_regressions.resolution: Do not use global safe.directory exceptions; keep the provenance worktree root-owned and build only from the exported source tree.

production_incidents_and_regressions.issue: Full-day backfill enriched source history and caused strict core-v1 recomputation to conflict with 104 already-frozen Phase 6 feature rows.
production_incidents_and_regressions.resolution: Add explicit preserve-existing expansion mode that skips immutable existing natural keys before source recomputation, verifies static target metadata, and generates only missing keys. Strict default generation remains conflict-detecting.
